meta.source: NASEO, Home Energy Rebates: State and Territory Energy Office Program Launches (HEEHR table last updated September 30, 2026); ENERGY STAR, HEEHR program page (maximum rebate amounts); each state program page opened on the check date
meta.notes: Federal High-Efficiency Electric Home Rebate (HEEHR, IRA section 50122) programs run by states. A state appears here only if NASEO's launch table lists it; eligibility is NASEO's summary, shortened. status: open = launched per NASEO and nothing on the state page we opened says it is closed; reserved = the state page says its funds are fully reserved. Pages that refused our checker (403) are marked pageChecked false and rely on NASEO alone. DOE's own program page says only that the rebates 'are now available in select states' (last updated July 8, 2026). Review every three months.
